scope: The seven LiquiLens core repositories, six declared research modules, and ten registered adjacent surfaces. NarcoScope is listed separately as an evidence-network route.

projects.label: LiquiLens
projects.role: Reviewer-facing, jurisdiction-specific financial evidence application and supported API composition.

analysis.reason: Desk bits, investigations, and historical case files are normalized into public MyQuant readings.

projects.label: LiquiLens Lab
projects.role: Shared temporal, evidence, evaluation, and decision contracts.

analysis.reason: It defines evidence contracts used upstream; it does not publish a separate editorial reading feed.

projects.label: LiquiLens v5 research
projects.role: Declared MFI research-module workspace.

analysis.reason: Research results require their own evidence and publication gate before becoming a public reading.

projects.label: Seiche
projects.role: Dollar-funding collection, history, research, and publication.

analysis.reason: Dispatches and investigations are normalized into public MyQuant readings.

projects.label: Riptide
projects.role: Scenario propagation, risk constraints, and decision simulation.

analysis.reason: Riptide emits bounded scenario artifacts; it has no approved public article feed and cannot authorize publication.

projects.label: Undertow US evidence provider
projects.role: Reviewed point-in-time US bank evidence collection, replay, features, and historical diagnostics.

analysis.reason: Approved public outputs arrive through LiquiLens desk and case-file records, not a second public Undertow feed.

projects.label: Undertow market liquidity
projects.role: Commodity, market-making, exit-liquidity, and funding-transmission research.

analysis.reason: Dispatches and eligible investigations are normalized into public MyQuant readings.

projects.label: v5 Backtest Harness
projects.role: Declared evaluation harness for the v5 MFI research workspace.

analysis.reason: A harness evaluates research; it is not itself a current market reading.

projects.label: v5 2019 NBFC Case Study
projects.role: Historical NBFC case-study module.

analysis.reason: Retrospective research must not be presented as a live or independently validated reading.

projects.label: v5 M1 CE Timing
projects.role: MFI timing research module.

analysis.reason: The module has no separately approved public reading contract.

projects.label: v5 M2 Velocity
projects.role: MFI velocity research module.

analysis.reason: The module has no separately approved public reading contract.

projects.label: v5 M3 Graph Contagion
projects.role: MFI graph-contagion research module.

analysis.reason: The module has no separately approved public reading contract.

projects.label: v5 M4 Concentration
projects.role: MFI concentration research module.

analysis.reason: The module has no separately approved public reading contract.

projects.label: LiquiLens CLI
projects.role: Terminal client for the public Failure Radar and evidence ledger.

analysis.reason: It delivers LiquiLens evidence and must not be counted as a second reading source.

projects.label: LiquiLens MCP listing
projects.role: Registry metadata for the hosted LiquiLens MCP server.

analysis.reason: The listing publishes no facts and must not duplicate the LiquiLens source record.

projects.label: Undertow MCP listing
projects.role: Registry metadata for the hosted Undertow MCP server.

analysis.reason: The listing publishes no facts and must not duplicate the Undertow source record.

projects.label: My Quant Doesn't Speak English
projects.role: Public reading layer for compatible, source-published evidence records.

analysis.reason: This site publishes explanations and house articles; it does not originate the specialist facts it interprets.

projects.label: MyQuant Intelligence
projects.role: Private provenance, review, evaluation, and training-eligibility authority.

analysis.reason: It can issue revision-bound review receipts but is not a source of current facts or automatic publication authority.

projects.label: MyQuant App
projects.role: Read-only client for the bounded MyQuant app feed.

analysis.reason: The public app feed and production distribution remain suspended, so it contributes no separate readings.

projects.label: LiquiLens public site
projects.role: Public evidence and documentation site for LiquiLens.

analysis.reason: The public site serves LiquiLens records; it is not a second scoring or reading engine.

projects.label: Palimpsest
projects.role: Public information-control, censorship-measurement, and sealed AI-evaluation desk.

analysis.reason: It publishes a separate evidence domain. MyQuant links it but does not blend its measurements into a financial reading.

projects.label: ScamShield
projects.role: Evidence-bounded triage of submitted or authorized Telegram messages.

analysis.reason: Private submitted messages and scam-typology evidence are outside the public financial-reading feed and are never auto-published here.

projects.label: Fleet Bots
projects.role: Private packaging and routing for six public Telegram bots and bounded news fan-out.

analysis.reason: Bot transport owns no editorial facts and must not be counted as a separate reading source.
It shares evidence standards but remains a separate subject and is not blended into financial readings.
